title: Correlated sign coupling identity
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $X$ be uniform on $\{-1,1\}$. Given $X$, let $Y=X$ with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and $Y=-X$ otherwise. For any functions $f,g:\{-1,1\}\to\mathbb R$, the expectation of $f(X)g(Y)$ is $f_{\mathrm e}g_{\mathrm e}+\rho f_{\mathrm o}g_{\mathrm o}$, where $f_{\mathrm e}=(f(1)+f(-1))/2$ and $f_{\mathrm o}=(f(1)-f(-1))/2$, and likewise for $g$.
